input.answer: From what I understood, the page says the cheapest way is an account at Psagot (פסגות) with the fund "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125". With 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month, that leaves 86,045 ₪ after 10 years, about 1,000 ₪ more than the next choice. The big banks come out lower and Altshuler, Excellence and Meitav much lower. I wouldn't open anything on my own from this, though. I'll ask you and the bank first, because I don't know who made this site and I didn't understand half the words.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the row of buttons at the top
stuck.why: It opens with English letters, MSCI World, S&P 500 and נאסד"ק. I almost left. I stayed only because I came for ת"א-125 and saw it was already chosen.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the four boxes and sliders
stuck.why: I don't know what 'תשואה בשנה 7%' is based on, and I didn't touch the sliders. I left the numbers in the boxes as they were.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the fund list on the left
stuck.why: Every line has a minus: -0.04%, -0.28%, -1,030 ₪. It scared me, it looked like losses. The small text at the bottom of screen 2 says it is 'מול המדד', but I only got to it later.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the long list of banks
stuck.why: Fifteen rows, each with its own number, coloured bar and grey line 'לא בחישוב מחיר אחר...'. By the bank Hapoalim I was tired.
Lines and stepped bars, I didn't try to read them. I only took the sentence 'אחרי המדרגות האלה אין בחירה אחרת שמשאירה יותר'.

findings.what: Every fund line has a minus sign, some in red bars. It reads like losses, and the explanation that it means 'compared with the index' is in small text far below.
findings.where: Screen 1–2, the fund list on the left

findings.what: Every bank row repeats the same grey line 'לא בחישוב מחיר אחר ל...' and its own coloured bar. I had to read it all again each time to find what was different.
The bar colours (orange, yellow, red, grey) are close to each other. The key that explains them is a separate row of small dots, so I had to look back and forth.
findings.where: Screen 1 'כמה זה עולה לכם' bars, and the accounts list

findings.what: Dark background with small pale grey text. Hard to read even enlarged.
findings.where: All screens, especially the notes and the explanations under the numbers

findings.what: The page opens with English index names before anything in Hebrew I know.
Sliders for the amounts. There are boxes too, but the sliders are the main thing.
Too many numbers on one screen: 86,045, 85,015, 70,000, 7,323, 8,353 and more. Only the first big one stuck with me.
I don't know who made the site, so I can't tell if I should trust it.
